title: DRAFT Data in Animal Welfare
text:
Meeting 2nd Feb
Main goals for meeting:

Flesh out idea

We need a chapter on basic stats at least, central tendency and spread, to support the reading of visualisations.
flowcharts on data choices?
need to pin down target audience
need to write the intro/disclaimer in a way that makes it clear what we are doing, this is not a course that equips you. This guide doesn’t cover data management etc.
data collection? Data sources? This might be in the intro?
sampling, generalisability, population vs sample, could go together with the data sources or intro?
How do I as a consumer of data react to a histogram? This is a diff audience to people who are dealing with data themselves.
This book is aimed at understanding animal welfare data not processing it
Audience is WORKING in animal welfare but non experts in data
Closing out chapter on applications of data in animal welfare
Final case study? You work for Hungry Hedgehogs, this is what you want to report, walk through it?
Bad science interpretation?

Specify chapter list
Introduction chapter containing disclaimer, audience pitch, explicit what its not going to cover (e.g. full stats etc)
Bad science chapter (Victoria first draft two parts? Build same case study throughout?)
sources of data (including a bit of ethics and AI - and remember the aim is you the animal welfare worker needing to use data, you’re not collecting it, data quality and source quality, quantity vs quality)
Data types (percentages, noir, prevalence and incidence, groups)
tidy data
intro to data visualisation (what is a chart why am I looking at it)
describing data (central tendncies, spread, transparency??, Victoria)
data relationships (highly data vis lean on it)
final case study
closing applications chapter
Decide on initial tasks

Jill to write a chapter template and word count parameter
Jill to look into interactivity
Jill to set up a technical meeting
Victoria bad science chapter initial draft
Jill to make a Teams site for document library purposes
Sarah tidy data

title: 1  Data in Animal Welfare
text:
When you work in animal welfare, you will probably encounter data in some form or another, whether it’s talking about the number of animals a charity has supported, or trying to get to grips with the prevalence of an animal welfare concern like tail docking.
